hq_country: United States (originally founded in New Zealand; HQ in Denver, Colorado)
target_vertical: Omnichannel retailers, multi-channel wholesalers/distributors, brands using 3PLs and EDI, mid-market DTC and B2B brands
pricing_model: Custom / quote-based; tailored by transaction volume, sales channels, warehouse locations, and required integrations (EDI, 3PL, etc.). Tiered enterprise pricing.
starting_price_usd: Custom-quoted (industry estimates ~USD 1,000-3,000+/month for typical Omni deployments) [uncertain]
free_trial_or_freemium: No public free trial or freemium tier; sales-led demo only [uncertain]
shopify_install_count: ~26 reviews on Shopify App Store; install count not publicly disclosed
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional: products/prices/stock pushed from Omni to Shopify; orders, customers, refunds/credit notes downloaded from Shopify to Omni.
shopify_synced_entities: Products, variants (up to 250 variants per product), inventory/stock levels, prices, sales orders, customers, fulfillments/dispatch updates, credit notes/refunds. Customer email notifications on fulfillment can be triggered from Shopify.
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes - multiple Shopify shops supported, but each requires a separate Shopify integration setup in Omni.
shopify_pos_support: Supported - Cin7 Omni can route sales orders by Shopify POS location/branch and allocate POS vs webstore orders to different GL accounts. Branches in Omni link to Shopify locations.
shopify_b2b_catalog_support: [uncertain] - no documented native handling of Shopify B2B catalogs / company locations / price lists
shopify_markets_support: Not supported - Shopify Markets is explicitly not supported by Omni (no multi-currency price upload, no per-Market order routing to different Omni branches per Cin7 help docs).
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: [uncertain] - no documented generic metafield mapping; mapping is primarily on standard product fields and variants
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Product options in Omni upload as Shopify variants (up to 250 variants per product). Mapping by SKU/code links Omni products to Shopify products/variants.
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Mixed - stock updates marketed as real-time on dispatch; product/order syncs run on configured schedules. Specific webhook vs polling architecture not fully documented publicly. [uncertain]
shopify_known_limitations: Shopify Markets unsupported; click-and-collect can sync to wrong branch (reported); exchanges not handled natively; updating prices can delete/remap variants per merchant reviews; click-and-collect and complex multi-location routing weak; low Shopify App Store rating (~1.8/5) with complaints about support response times.
etsy_native_or_third_party: Direct native integration to Etsy via Cin7 Omni
etsy_listing_creation_vs_sync_only: Sync-only - Etsy products are downloaded into Omni and matched by SKU; you cannot export/create new Etsy listings from Omni.
etsy_inventory_sync: Stock levels push from Omni to Etsy once channel is selected on the product; pricing also pushes; updates via product page or bulk import.
etsy_order_import: Orders downloaded automatically from Etsy on schedule (real-time/near-real-time not explicitly documented). [uncertain]
etsy_synced_entities: Products (matched by SKU), variations, inventory/stock, pricing, sales orders/receipts. Listing creation not supported.
etsy_known_limitations: Cannot create/export new Etsy listings from Omni (only sync existing). No MPF tax handling for Etsy (Cin7 MPF support is Amazon-only). Personalization/digital products handling not specifically documented. [uncertain]
amazon_marketplaces: Global Amazon marketplaces supported (US, UK, EU, AU, CA and others) [uncertain on full list]
amazon_seller_types: FBA and FBM (Seller Central) supported, plus Amazon Vendor Central via EDI workflow (850 ORDERS, etc.)
amazon_synced_entities: Listings, inventory, sales orders, FBA shipments, returns, settlements. EDI flows (850/856/810/etc.) for Vendor Central via Cin7 EDI module.
amazon_listing_creation: [uncertain] - primarily syncs existing listings; listing creation depth not fully documented
amazon_repricing_support: Not built-in [uncertain]; relies on third-party repricers
amazon_buy_shipping: [uncertain] - no documented in-app Amazon Buy Shipping label purchase
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: Supported via Set up Amazon FBA flow and FBA overview docs; specific UI for inbound plan creation provided. Implementation depth around prep/label workflows not fully documented publicly. [uncertain]
amazon_sp_api_inbound_v2024_03_20: [uncertain] - no public statement confirming migration to Fulfillment Inbound v2024-03-20
amazon_settlement_report_handling: Amazon settlement data is reconciled in Omni and posted to accounting (Xero/QBO) via the accounting integration's reconciliation workflow [uncertain on exact journal granularity]
amazon_marketplace_facilitator_tax_handl: Amazon MPF orders are downloaded as Tax Exempt in Cin7 Omni so duplicate tax is not posted to accounting. MPF handling is currently Amazon-only - not supported for eBay/Walmart/Etsy.
amazon_multi_account_support: Multiple Amazon accounts/marketplaces supported via separate integration connections per tenant [uncertain on hard limits]
amazon_known_limitations: MPF tax handling limited to Amazon (not eBay/Walmart/Etsy); no native repricer; Buy Shipping integration not documented; SP-API Inbound v2024-03-20 migration status not publicly confirmed.
xero_app_store_certified: Yes - listed on the Xero App Store as a certified app
xero_app_awards_recognition: [uncertain] - no current Xero Global App Award status confirmed for 2025/2026
xero_app_store_rating: ~4.0 / 5 with ~228 reviews on the Xero App Store
xero_synced_entities: Sales invoices, purchase bills, payments, customers/contacts, suppliers, COGS journals, stock-on-hand journals, inventory adjustments, additional stock cost journals, credit notes, tax/GST.
xero_accounting_sync_mode: Invoice-per-order (or hybrid) - Omni posts individual sale invoices and purchase bills to Xero, plus COGS/inventory journals. Summary-journal mode is not the standard pattern (A2X-style). [uncertain on configurable summary mode]
xero_cogs_journal_method: Perpetual per-movement COGS journals tied to dispatches, with landed cost inclusive (freight/duty/insurance allocated into inventory cost via landed-cost feature).
xero_multi_currency: Yes - foreign-currency POs and invoices supported, with daily Xe.com rate refresh used for purchase order exchange rates.
xero_tracking_category_mapping: Supported - Omni transactions can be mapped to Xero tracking categories (e.g., by branch or sales channel) [uncertain on full scope]
xero_tax_handling: Tax codes mapped between Omni tax rules and Xero tax rates; Amazon MPF orders downloaded as tax-exempt to avoid duplicate tax journaling.
xero_known_limitations: Some orders reported as posting in 'open' status requiring manual reconciliation; reconciliation between Omni inventory value (goods received) and Xero (goods paid) can drift; manual sync of pending transactions required from Accounting menu.
qb_online_supported: Yes - native QuickBooks Online integration (listed on the Intuit App Store).
qb_desktop_supported: [uncertain] - no clear native QuickBooks Desktop integration documented for Omni
qb_app_certified: Listed on the Intuit App Store (QuickBooks Apps); certification specifics not detailed [uncertain]
qb_app_store_rating: [uncertain] - Intuit App Store rating/review count not surfaced in current sources
qb_synced_entities: Sales invoices, purchase bills, payments, customers, vendors/suppliers, inventory adjustments, COGS journals, stock-on-hand journals, credit memos, tax mappings.
qb_accounting_sync_mode: Invoice-per-order (or hybrid) - similar pattern to Xero; individual invoices/bills plus inventory/COGS journals posted to QBO.
qb_cogs_journal_method: Perpetual per-movement COGS, landed-cost inclusive (same costing engine as Xero integration).
qb_multi_currency: Yes - multi-currency posting supported in line with QBO's multi-currency [uncertain on full feature parity]
qb_class_location_mapping: [uncertain] - QBO Class/Location dimension mapping not explicitly documented in surfaced sources
qb_known_limitations: Same general reconciliation drift between Omni inventory value and QBO inventory value (goods received vs goods paid); manual sync from Accounting dashboard required for pending transactions.
other_ecom_channels: Native or pre-built: BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Magento, eBay, Walmart Marketplace, Etsy, Amazon, Wayfair, Faire (via partners/EDI), Square, plus custom storefront support. TikTok Shop available via partners/iPaaS (Pipe17), not direct native. Cin7 advertises 500-700+ integrations across the broader Cin7 ecosystem.
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes - BOM types include addon/kit BOMs where component stock decrements and finished-product stock increments on sale/PO. Production BOMs also explode components.
other_accounting_integrations: Xero and QuickBooks Online are the primary native accounting integrations. Sage and NetSuite are often referenced as competitors rather than supported integrations; no native MYOB/Sage Intacct/Zoho Books integrations broadly advertised for Omni. [uncertain]
bom_support: Yes - native BOM module (Make BOMs, addon BOMs, production BOMs).
multi_level_bom: Yes - nested/multi-level BOMs supported (production BOM explosion / nested production orders).
production_orders: Yes - production jobs with components, due dates, BOM cost calculations, and contract-manufacturing cost capture. Routings/operations support exists but is more advanced in Cin7 Core's Advanced Manufacturing Module. [uncertain on Omni routings depth]
batch_lot_tracking: Yes - batch/lot costing and tracking supported.
bin_location_support: Yes - bin/aisle/sub-location tracking supported within warehouses (Warehouse Management functionality).
multi_warehouse: Yes - multiple branches/warehouses with stock transfers and per-branch routing.
barcoding: Yes - barcode generation, label printing, and barcode scanner support (Zebra, ScanSKU, ION 2D Bluetooth, etc.).
purchase_orders: Yes - POs with partial receipts, supplier price lists, foreign-currency POs, landed-cost allocation, and 3PL-linked PO sync.
supplier_management: Yes - supplier records, supplier-SKU mapping, lead times, MOQs, pricing tiers, and contract manufacturer workflows.
landed_cost_support: Yes - import/freight/duty/insurance costs allocated to inventory by value, weight or cubic meter; foreign-currency import costs supported.
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: Inventory valued in base/local currency; foreign-currency purchase costs converted at PO exchange rate (daily Xe.com refresh).
ai_demand_forecasting: Yes - Cin7 ForesightAI (acquired from Inventoro) built into Core and Omni. Runs ~100 forecasting algorithms over up to 2 years of sales history, refreshes every 12 hours, forecasts up to 24 months ahead. Add-on to base subscription.
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Yes - Smart Replenishment in ForesightAI evaluates predicted demand, calculates optimized reorder points, and automatically generates PO drafts.
ai_natural_language_query: [uncertain] - no public chat/NL inventory query feature documented for Omni
public_api: Yes - REST/JSON public API at https://api.cin7.com with Swagger docs; basic auth (username + unique API key per connection).
webhook_event_coverage: Webhooks available, though webhook event catalog and depth are not as prominently documented as the REST API surface. [uncertain on full event list]
integration_architecture: Native first-party integrations for major channels (Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BigCommerce, Etsy, Xero, QBO) plus native EDI/3PL modules. Zapier/Make available for long-tail apps. iPaaS partners (Pipe17, Celigo, Syncware) also bridge to Omni.
zapier_make_support: Yes - Zapier connector available; Make.com (Integromat) app also available.
mobile_app: Mobile app exists for warehouse/inventory/POS workflows; Cin7 Core has dedicated iOS/Android WMS/POS apps. Omni-specific mobile app capability is more focused on warehouse/WMS use cases. [uncertain on Omni-only native app branding]
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Yes - mobile/handheld barcode scanning supported (Cin7 WMS app + tested hardware scanners including Zebra CS60, ScanSKU, ION 2D Bluetooth).
rate_limit_handling_documented: Public API documents authentication and endpoints but rate-limit handling for Shopify/Amazon/Xero/QBO downstream is not deeply documented publicly. [uncertain]
sync_frequency: Varies per integration: Shopify stock updates marketed as real-time on dispatch; ForesightAI refreshes every 12 hours; other connectors run on scheduled intervals (configurable). Exact frequencies per connector not always publicly documented. [uncertain]
shipping_carrier_integrations: Direct integrations with ShipStation, Starshipit, Shiptheory (which in turn give USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, Canada Post, Royal Mail, AusPost, etc.). Direct single-carrier integrations are limited; most carrier connectivity is via shipping aggregators.
shipping_label_buying: In-app label purchase is provided indirectly via ShipStation/Starshipit/Shiptheory integrations rather than as a native Cin7 label-buying engine.
three_pl_integrations: Yes - native 3PL module with EDI/3PL Portal, routing instructions, cartonization workflows, and PO sync to linked 3PLs. Differentiator vs Cin7 Core.
edi_support: Yes - native EDI module (850/856/810/etc.) with major-retailer support (Amazon Vendor, Walmart, Target, etc.); Cin7 acts as the EDI provider via the EDI/3PL Portal.
g2_rating: [uncertain] - exact current G2 star rating/review count not surfaced; Capterra ~4.3-4.5/5 across ~297-597 reviews
g2_grid_quadrant: [uncertain] - public G2 Grid quadrant placement for 2025/2026 not confirmed in current sources
notable_customers: Friction Labs, Ecolife Solutions, Workplace Depot, Decibullz, VULCAN Fitness, Smidge Beverage Co., Eleven86, TOST, Rare Tea Company, Two Leaves and a Bud, Marshfield Farm Ice Cream, Avenida Home, Monsterthreads, Waddle & Friends, ONEBYONE, Zulu & Zephyr, New Farm Confectionery. 8,000+ customers across 100+ countries.
last_major_release: Cin7 ForesightAI (AI demand forecasting and smart replenishment) following Cin7's acquisition of Inventoro (announced 2024); ongoing rollout into 2025/2026. [uncertain on exact most-recent release item]
owner_parent_company: Cin7 is owned by Rubicon Technology Partners (US private equity firm). Majority investment originally in October 2019; in November 2024 Rubicon closed a $500M single-asset continuation fund (with CVC Secondary Partners as lead investor, plus Ares, BlackRock, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and Schroders Capital) to extend its ownership of Cin7.
last_funding_event: November 2024 - Rubicon Technology Partners closed a $500M single-asset continuation fund to extend its ownership of Cin7 (CVC Secondary Partners as lead investor).
public_status_page_uptime: https://status.cin7.com - public status page covering 37 components / 3 component groups across Omni, Core, API and login services. Recent uptime trending ~100% per Cin7's status page; third-party monitors (IsDown) have logged frequent smaller incidents (~4.9/month in 2025).
